title: seris onoseroides
intro: Seris onoseroides, commonly known as the Mexican evening primrose, is a flowering plant native to Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids are responsible for its medicinal properties, which have been studied for their potential in treating conditions like insomnia and digestive issues.
